bluf: Terakeet is a founder led Syracuse agency, founded in 2001 by cofounders MacLaren Cummings, the CEO, and Patrick Danial, that has recast enterprise SEO as reputation control: it sells itself as the reputation operating system for large enterprises and their leaders across organic and AI search. The record shows it pushing that line now, with 14 LinkedIn company ads, case studies refreshed on 2026-07-17 and an AI search post in September 2026. A rival should know its proof is anonymous and self defined: no client is named in the record, and its headline 94% controllability figure has no stated method.
doing:
The positioning line, the reputation operating system for large enterprises and their leaders, shaping how they appear in organic and AI search, decodes as reputation management sold as search: it builds and activates brand assets the client controls so that those, not negative results or misinformation, fill the top results on Google and the answers in AI assistants. The headline claim, a case study reporting 94% controllability of ChatGPT and Gemini answers for a financial industry leader, is quoted as a claim; the record does not say how controllability is measured.

The sold mix is narrow, breadth 3, with only two services listed, Reputation Management and Generative AI Optimization. It leads with AI Search / GEO at 3, on a Generative AI Optimization nav offer, GEO on the about page and the 94% case, and with SEO at 3, where the meta frames reputation control across organic search and cases describe owning Google top 10 results. Content & Digital PR scores 2 on an Optimize step that builds and activates owned brand assets. The proprietary names are the Reputation Operating System and the Brand Intel Report; the record lists no partners.

The AI posture is control, not production: it sells shaping how ChatGPT and Gemini portray brands and executives, backed by what it calls patented monitoring technology, while AI Automation / Agents scores 0. Dated moves run from Company of the Year in advertising, marketing and PR at the 2024 American Business Awards, through Built In Best Workplaces and Digiday Most Innovative Culture finalist places in 2025 and 2026, to case studies refreshed on 2026-07-17, a blog post on AI search questions (2026-09-11) and one marking Terakeet at 25 (2026-09-25). It lists 3 openings, two for a digital content specialist and one for a project manager. No pricing signal appears. Conspicuously absent: any named client, any measurement line and any paid media.
clients:
The ICP is enterprise: the leadership page says the CEO built it into a marketing partner to Fortune 500 brands. The record lists five verticals, financial services, insurance, media and entertainment, technology, and public figures and executives, and the home market is the US, served from Syracuse.

The needs read holds no named clients, so none is names only and none is shared with another tracked agency: every case in the record is anonymous, which suits discretion in reputation work and leaves a rival no account list. The eight case studies the record excerpts, of 16 the deepen pass counted, all last modified 2026-07-17, still show what these buyers came for; read against the need taxonomy, and inferred because the needs read codes none of them, that is mostly PR, reputation and content plus organic demand. An entertainment executive came to own page one, with 100% of Google top 10 results turned favorable. A global financial services brand came to correct misinformation and secure top results. An international sports brand removed negative results and, by the excerpt, grew brand control by 62%. A prominent public figure secured Google's top results after controversy. AI and automation needs appear in three cases: a financial industry leader credited with 94% controllability over ChatGPT and Google Gemini, an insurer credited with AI search visibility, qualified traffic and record conversions, and a global software company optimizing for both search and AI.

What the base needs next: under KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) these clients very likely keep buying control of AI answers, its tailwind, while under KJ2 (ads inside AI answers scale faster than any channel before them) they will likely need paid defense inside those answers, a line the record does not show (moderate confidence).
house: Say and do: 1 of 1 tested lines practised, the publishing cadence test, corroborated on 0 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and 49 in 365. That zero sits against the deepen pass, which read 640 sitemap URLs against the compile's 296 and found blog posts dated 2026-09-11, 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-25, so the 90 day figure very likely undercounts. The AI Search / GEO test is unknown because the llms.txt check did not complete; 9 AI topic URLs register and no AI crawlers are blocked. The Radar lists no gaps. The stack is WordPress, gtm, Complianz and Dealfront Leadfeeder (ABM), with no social pixels or test tools. Its Transparency Center record shows 1 Google text ad, last shown 2026-09-16. LinkedIn is the working channel: 16 ads match the name query, 14 company page ads on the first page plus 2 dynamic job ads; one opens, "In 2026, people will believe the narratives they see first."
market:
The Horus read scores Terakeet 21 on the tailwind index, Favored band, percentile 72. It is best placed for KJ1, the click is being replaced by the citation (net 0.547, driven by AI Search / GEO), and KJ2, ads inside AI answers scale faster than any channel before them (net 0.328). It is most exposed to KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out (net -0.422, SEO and Content & Digital PR), and KJ9, measurement gets worse before it gets better (net -0.328, SEO). Best fit is The Toll Road at 81/100. It is partial on P1, unknown on P5 and absent on P2, P6 and P7.

The Monsoon read is 62.9, band Onshore wind, percentile 78, with migration 65.4 above displacement 60.4. The verdict puts 65 of it in the sold mix, SEO (34) and AI Search / GEO (18) carrying the most movable hours, and sends the work 65% to South and Southeast Asia and 25% to Latin America. The footprint is inferred: no hub office, no onshore claim, and the enterprise ICP takes 5 points off.
openings:
The strongest opening is the proof. Its headline is 94% controllability of ChatGPT and Gemini answers, a measure the record never defines, for an unnamed financial industry leader; every case is anonymous, and P1 is only partial despite its claim of patented monitoring technology. A rival bringing an audited AI visibility scorecard with a stated method is likely, moderate confidence, to win enterprise buyers who must defend spend as KJ9 bites. Falsifier: a published controllability method, or a named client case with audited figures, on terakeet.com.

The entity layer is the second front: it sells control of how AI portrays brands and executives, yet no feed, schema or entity work shows (P2 absent), so structured entity work is an offer it cannot match from the record. KJ2 is a tailwind it cannot sell into, with paid lines at 0, so reputation defense that includes paid placement inside AI answers has a roughly even chance to land, low confidence while that price is unsettled. It publishes no pricing model either.

With no named clients, contestable accounts come from its verticals, financial services, insurance and public figures first. The computed idle sitemap opening is wrong: its blog posts are dated September 2026.
watch: Indicator I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, next reading late October 2026: growth below 10% would flag cannibalization of the Google top 10 results its reputation cases are built on, while above 15% with AI Mode ads live would confirm S1.

Indicator I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, read on a rolling basis: the next milestone ($2B) and any pricing below $20 CPM would test KJ2, its second tailwind, which it has no paid line to serve.
Indicator I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, next reading October 2026: output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would sharpen KJ6, its largest exposure.

Indicator I10, Reddit US daily users versus search referral volatility, next reading late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth would confirm the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.

Follow up the 2026-09-25 post marking Terakeet at 25, the case studies last modified 2026-07-17 and its 3 open roles: a named client or a defined controllability method would be the first hard proof in its record.

The next Radar compile refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients; this dossier is only as fresh as the 2026-09-28 compile, whose sitemap reading of 296 URLs should be reconciled with the 640 the deepen pass read.
